definitions.gloss: beef tallow; beef suet; rendered beef fat
definitions.explanation: The hard white fat rendered from cattle, used in cooking, soap making, and industrial applications. In Japanese cooking, small blocks of beef tallow are commonly provided at yakiniku and teppanyaki restaurants to grease the grill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: Rub beef tallow on the griddle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I got some beef tallow at the yakiniku restaurant and rubbed it on the grill.

examples.japanese: {牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: Stir-frying with beef tallow enhances the flavor.

notes:
Compound of {牛|ぎゅう} ('cow; cattle; beef') and {脂|し} ('fat; tallow'). The solid white fat rendered from beef, with a high melting point that makes it useful for greasing cooking surfaces.

USAGE:
- At ⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧ (yakiniku) and {鉄板焼|てっぱんやき} (teppanyaki) restaurants, small cubes of {牛脂|ぎゅうし} are often provided free of charge to grease the grill before cooking.
- In home cooking, {牛脂|ぎゅうし} can be obtained free from the meat counter at supermarkets — simply ask the butcher.
- Also used historically in soap and candle making, and industrially as a lubricant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to rub beef tallow (on a cooking surface)
- {牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry with beef tallow
- {牛脂|ぎゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧: to melt beef tallow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {豚脂|とんし}: lard; pork fat — the equivalent rendered fat from pigs
- ⟦ラード→ラード：13638_raado⟧: lard — the loanword for rendered pork fat, commonly used in Japanese cooking
- ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧: butter — dairy fat, also used for cooking but with a different flavor profile
- ⟦{脂身|あぶらみ}→脂身：20673_aburami⟧: fatty part (of meat) — the fat still attached to a cut of meat, as opposed to rendered tallow
